falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern requires lower highs and failed rallies; a breakout above the August 2024 high invalidates the structural similarity and suggests the correction ended, not a bottom forming

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 implies elevated volatility compression risk; sustained VIX sub-14 indicates panic has fully cleared and the market is pricing normalcy, contradicting a bottoming process with residual fear

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 5 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom coincided with rate relief; if yields fall this far without stocks ripping higher, it signals growth scare dominance rather than a tradable bottom, breaking the pattern's rate-stability requirement
